verdict.rationale: Lium documents scoped API keys whose scopes are fixed at creation, plus per-key daily, monthly and lifetime USD budgets enforced by the server. That covers the credential and spend-control half of the story well. The evidence never mentions team members, organizations or role-based access, so the team-management half is unsupported. Missing for 10: team/org member management, role-based permissions, independent or hands-on corroboration of scoped-key and budget enforcement.
